name: Planisware Orchestra
description_en:
Planisware Orchestra is a cloud project-portfolio management platform aimed at PMOs that need to connect project selection with delivery and shared resources. Its public product material describes scoring and scenario comparisons, capacity planning, project cost/status reporting and configurable workflows. It is a particular Planisware product, so this record does not import every capability of Enterprise, Horizon, Nova or Valoris.

The central evaluation question is whether a portfolio decision can be traced to consistent project, cost and resource data. A dashboard cannot repair incompatible estimates or stale actuals by itself. The proposed examples below show how to examine that chain, with clear boundaries between published capabilities, version-specific material and untested implementation.
description_zh:
Planisware Orchestra 是面向 PMO 的云端项目组合管理平台，用于连接项目选择、交付与共享资源。公开产品资料介绍了评分与情景对比、产能规划、项目成本／状态报告及可配置流程。它是 Planisware 旗下特定产品，本档案不把 Enterprise、Horizon、Nova 或 Valoris 的全部能力混入其中。

关键评估问题是：组合决策能否追溯到一致的项目、成本和资源数据。仪表盘本身不能修复口径不同的估算或过时的实际数据。以下建议样例用于检查这条链，并区分公开能力、特定版本资料与未测试实现。

review_notes: English and Chinese were checked against the sources attached to each section. Editorial examples and selection judgments are not customer evidence.
Read_at is retrieval time; public-reader text may be cached and does not establish vendor update time.
Draft documentation research only. Independent review, hands-on testing, owner verification and publishing approval remain separate.

sections.title_en: Test a decision that crosses two projects
sections.title_zh: 用跨两个项目的决定检验组合管理
sections.en:
Suppose two initiatives need the same designer in the same month. Record each initiative’s objective, proposed timing, expected cost and resource demand, then compare a scenario where one is deferred with a scenario where both proceed. The product page describes a consistent scoring framework and comparison against financial and capacity plans.

Keep the scoring rationale visible. A higher score is a result of chosen criteria, not proof of objectively greater business value. Ask the demonstration to show which input caused a selection or capacity conflict and what changes after the deferral. This is a hypothetical evaluation, not a result produced in Orchestra.
sections.zh:
假设两项计划在同一月份都需要同一位设计师。可以记录各项目标、建议时间、预期成本和资源需求，再比较推迟其中一项与同时推进的情景。产品页介绍了统一评分框架，以及结合财务和产能计划进行比较的能力。

应保留评分理由。分数更高是所选标准的结果，不能证明客观业务价值必然更大。演示时应检查哪个输入引发选中或产能冲突，以及延期后发生什么变化。这是假设评估，本次没有在 Orchestra 中生成结果。

sections.title_en: Separate a project’s demand from allocation authority
sections.title_zh: 区分项目需求与资源分配权
sections.en:
An official version8.1 workshop distinguishes direct Gantt allocation, estimates on work items, and supply/demand with dedicated resource managers. Its prerequisites include projects, budget lines, units and load plans. This is useful evidence of the model, rather than a current screen-by-screen tutorial.

For the shared-designer example, decide whether the project manager can directly allocate time or requests capacity from a resource manager. Agree the unit and working period before comparing projects. Include non-project commitments in the test input; otherwise apparently spare capacity may be an artifact of missing data. Request the workflow for the version being purchased.
sections.zh:
官方 8.1 版本培训区分了 Gantt 直接分配、工作项估算，以及由专门资源经理处理的供需模式；前提知识包括项目、预算行、单位和负荷计划。它能证明模型思路，但不是当前界面的逐步教程。

对于共享设计师样例，应明确项目经理能否直接分配时间，还是需要向资源经理申请产能。跨项目比较前要统一单位和工作周期，并把非项目承诺放入测试输入，否则表面空闲可能只是数据缺失。采购时需按实际版本演示流程。

sections.title_en: Reconcile a small financial period before scaling reports
sections.title_zh: 扩大报告前先核对一个小财务周期
sections.en:
The 26Q1 demo’s written overview describes budgets, forecasts, actuals and multiple baselines across periods, together with capacity views across resource structures. It also describes exporting application pages as editable PowerPoint content. These are release-description claims; the video and a live export were not tested.

For a pilot, choose one project and period, identify the source of actual cost, and reconcile it with the report before aggregating the portfolio. Keep a baseline distinct from the current forecast. Inspect a generated slide for numbers, labels and editability instead of assuming an exported presentation remains synchronized forever.
sections.zh:
26Q1 演示的文字说明介绍了跨周期预算、预测、实际值和多个基线，以及跨资源结构的产能视图，还说明可把应用页面导出为可编辑 PowerPoint 内容。这些属于版本说明主张，本次没有观看视频或测试真实导出。

试点可选择一个项目和一个周期，确定实际成本来源，再核对报告，之后才汇总组合。基线应与当前预测分开。生成幻灯片后应检查数字、标签和可编辑性，不能假设导出演示文稿会一直同步更新。

sections.title_en: Check generated proposals against portfolio evidence
sections.title_zh: 用组合依据核对生成建议
sections.en:
The public brochure page names Oscar, generated work breakdown structures and schedules, auto-tagging and an LLM connector. The 26Q1 description adds document-to-project creation and project summaries. Neither source establishes the exact quota, model availability or approval controls for a specific contract.

A useful demonstration would use a small non-sensitive brief with explicit dates, constraints and missing information. Inspect what is filled in, what is inferred and whether a person can review the proposal before adoption. Do not treat a coherent summary as validation that the schedule, cost or resource assumptions are correct.
sections.zh:
公开宣传册页面列出 Oscar、生成工作分解结构和日程、自动标签及 LLM 连接器；26Q1 说明还介绍从文档创建项目及项目摘要。两者都不能确立具体合同的额度、模型可用性或审批控制。

演示可以使用一份不含敏感数据、写明日期／约束／缺失信息的小简报，检查哪些内容被填入、哪些属于推断，以及采用前能否人工审阅。摘要逻辑通顺，不能验证日程、成本或资源假设正确。

sections.title_en: Budget for maintaining the application and interfaces
sections.title_zh: 为应用与接口维护安排责任
sections.en:
The managed-services page offers administration, configuration, data maintenance, interface monitoring, migration/UAT and reporting/BI expertise. Their inclusion in a particular subscription is not established by that page. A vendor-hosted application can still require an organizational owner for business definitions and data quality.

Name the owner of resource structures, financial mappings and report definitions. Ask a demonstration to show a delayed or failed source update and how the operator detects and repairs it without double-counting. This review found no product-specific retry, idempotency or recovery guarantee and did not test an interface.
sections.zh:
托管服务页面列出管理、配置、数据维护、接口监控、迁移／UAT 及报告／BI 专业服务，但该页不能证明具体订阅包含哪些项目。即使应用由厂商托管，组织仍需负责业务定义和数据质量。

应指定资源结构、财务映射和报告定义的负责人。演示时可要求展示来源更新延迟或失败，以及操作人员如何发现、修复并避免重复计数。本次没有找到产品专属重试、幂等或恢复保证，也未测试接口。

sections.title_en: Request a scoped quote, not a borrowed seat price
sections.title_zh: 索取明确范围报价，不套用旧席位价
sections.en:
The 2025 registration report describes Orchestra as SaaS with subscription pricing. Contracts specify users and a base service scope; extra users, consulting, hosting and storage may cost more. It does not establish a current universal seat price.

Request an Orchestra-specific quote listing users, capabilities, implementation, integrations, support and exit/export conditions. Keep the subscription and optional managed services separate in the estimate. No quote was requested and no free plan or trial entitlement was confirmed.
sections.zh:
2025 年登记报告将 Orchestra 描述为订阅计费的 SaaS。合同规定用户和基础服务范围，额外用户、咨询、托管及存储可能另收费；报告不能确立当前统一席位价。

应索取针对 Orchestra、列明用户、能力、实施、集成、支持和退出／导出条件的报价，并在估算中区分订阅与可选托管服务。本次没有询价，也未确认免费套餐或试用权益。

sections.title_en: Keep the hosting and product boundaries explicit
sections.en:
The report says that retrieving customer data after termination does not grant the right to run Planisware software on the customer’s own infrastructure. Public cloud wording should not be read as an open-source or self-hosting license.

Shortlist Orchestra for a PMO prepared to standardize portfolio inputs and maintain resource and financial definitions. A small team wanting only a shared checklist may find that governance work disproportionate. Confirm the proposed release and contractual hosting/recovery conditions; public brochures and demo descriptions do not substitute for an account-specific implementation test. The brochure PDF itself required a contact form and was not read.
sections.zh:
报告说明，终止后取回客户数据不意味着获得在客户自有基础设施运行 Planisware 软件的权利。云端描述不能解读为开源或自托管许可。

如果 PMO 愿意统一组合输入并维护资源及财务定义，可以列入候选；只需要共享清单的小团队，可能不适合承担这类治理工作。应确认拟采用版本，以及合同托管／恢复条件；公开宣传页和演示说明不能替代账户具体实施测试。宣传册 PDF 本身需要填写联系表，本次没有读取。

seo.title_zh: Planisware Orchestra：组合情景、资源需求与采用条件
seo.description_en: Evaluate Orchestra scoring, capacity, financial reporting, AI proposals and ongoing administration with product-specific sources.
seo.description_zh: 依据产品专属来源评估 Orchestra 评分、产能、财务报告、AI 建议及持续管理。
secondary_questions: What belongs in an Orchestra quote?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent hypotheses; no measured search volume or ranking.

research_gaps.en: No live account, video observation, scenario, AI output, connector, export, recovery or load test. Public training is version-specific; latest available/purchased release and exact workflows require confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试真实账户、观看视频、情景、AI 输出、连接器、导出、恢复或负载。公开培训针对特定版本，最新可用／采购版本和具体流程需确认。

research_gaps.en: Commercial quote, user/license tiers, implementation scope, model quotas, full contract, data residency/SLA, interface languages and regional availability remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 商业报价、用户／许可档位、实施范围、模型额度、完整合同、数据驻留／SLA、界面语言与地区可用性仍未核实。
